summary: REQUEST_CHANGES: generation-2 harness lifecycle invalidation still depends on Destroying/AncestryChanged callback scheduling. Under deferred signal delivery, external destroy/reparent can mutate the Model while private current remains observable until the queued callback runs, so get/start/restart can still observe stale ownership in the same task.

validation.notes: start() asserts current == nil and get() returns current without synchronous ownership/liveness reconciliation; lifecycle cleanup is entered only from engine signal callbacks.
Regression proves source tokens/order for lifecycle hooks but does not model the post-destroy/reparent pre-callback window, so it can false-pass the stale-current race.
Canonical validate job is green for this head lineage.
Engine/source tests are green; pr-ownership remains separately fail-closed behind the active trusted-history recovery and is not waived by this review.

details.blockingInvariant: External destruction or reparenting must not leave a stale private owner observable, regardless of engine signal scheduling.
